text:
Dawn dazzles the eye

Sirens tear the sky

Taxi horns resound in the street

Broken car horns bleat bleat bleat


The sky is covered with words

The day is covered with words

The night is covered with words

God is covered with words


Consciousness covered with words

Mind covered with words

Life and death are words

Words are covered with words


Lovers are covered with words

Murderers are covered with words

Spies are covered with words

Governments covered with words


Mustard gas covered with words

Hydrogen bombs covered with words

“News” of the world is words

Wars are covered with words


Secret police covered with words

Hunger covered with words

Mothers’ bones covered with words

Skeletal children made of words


Armies are covered with words

Money covered with words

High Finance covered with words

Jungles of poverty covered with words


Electric chairs covered with words

The shouting crowd is covered with words

Tyrant radios covered with words

Televised Hell, covered with words

translation.title: Celestial Words
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the supplied Spanish rendering of Ginsberg, not recovered from the original English; the incantatory repetition and catalog structure are preserved.
